clips.title: The story
paras: In the Sepulcher, Trevan Rol spots an unusual pair passing through Silverpine Forest. The tauren and high elf travel under the Earthen Ring's banner, a rare sight in Horde territory that draws suspicion.

Trevan Rol sees two travelers claiming to represent the Earthen Ring pass along the road by the Sepulcher. The outpost is a grim waystation where strangers, especially those on diplomatic business, draw close scrutiny. A tauren traveling under the shamanic order's banner raises little surprise. His cloaked companion is another matter: the scout recognizes an unmistakable high elf, a sight that strikes the Forsaken as exceedingly strange.

A high elf traveling openly beside a member of the Horde's shamanic circles raises questions among the Forsaken sentries. The Earthen Ring concerns itself with the balance of the elements, and high elves are rarely seen in Lordaeron, much less as companions to tauren envoys. To learn where the pair went and what business brought them to the forest, you are directed to Deathguard Baldren at the edge of town.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A high elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.
Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
